mapper.sql: id, client_code, client_name, contract_code, contract_name, plan_date, rent_amount, principal_amount, interest_amount, principal_tax, interest_tax, outflow_amount, planned_interest, planned_principal, cash_flow, opening_amortized_cost, ending_amortized_cost, actual_daily_rate, rental_income, service_fee_amortization_rate, service_fee_amortization_income, xirr_rate, actual_repayment_date, actual_repayment_principal_balance, actual_repayment_principal_amount, actual_repayment_interes_balance, actual_repayment_interes_amount, recapture_status, overdue_earnings, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag, message_id, system_code, periods, org_id, accrued, income_provision_method, amortized, comment, source_irr_rate
mapper.select: select count(1) from ( select contract_code from eg_repayment_plan_hy where del_flag = '0' and periods=-1 group by contract_code ) a

select
from eg_repayment_plan_hy where del_flag = '0' and contract_code in ( select contract_code from eg_repayment_plan_hy erph where del_flag = '0' and periods=-1 group by contract_code order by contract_code limit #{pageSize} offset #{pageNum} ) order by contract_code , plan_date

select oai.contract_code as contractCode , coalesce(hy.cashFlowSum,0) as cashFlowSum, oai.end_balance_for oustandingAmount, oaia.end_balance_for residualValueAmount, (coalesce(hy.cashFlowSum,0) + (coalesce(oai.end_balance_for, 0) + coalesce(na.service_no_amortization_amout, 0))) * -1 as cashflowInit from ( select contract_code contractCode, sum(cash_flow) cashFlowSum from eg_repayment_plan_hy where del_flag ='0' and plan_date > #{params.initDate} group by contract_code order by contract_code ) hy right join ( select contract_code, account_number, sum(end_balance_for) end_balance_for from eg_outstanding_amount_init where account_number in ('1532.01', '1505.03.02') and coalesce(end_balance_for, 0) != 0 group by contract_code , account_number ) oai on hy.contractCode = oai.contract_code left join eg_service_no_amortization na on na.contract_code = hy.contractCode left join ( select contract_code, account_number, sum(end_balance_for) end_balance_for from eg_outstanding_amount_init where account_number = '1531.01.03' group by contract_code , account_number ) oaia on hy.contractCode = oaia.contract_code where oai.contract_code is not null
and oai.contract_code = #{params.contractCode}

select t1.id, t1.client_code, t1.client_name, t1.contract_code, t1.contract_name, t1.plan_date, t1.rent_amount, t1.principal_amount, t1.interest_amount, t1.principal_tax, t1.interest_tax, t1.outflow_amount, t1.planned_interest, t1.planned_principal, t1.cash_flow, t1.opening_amortized_cost, t1.ending_amortized_cost, t1.actual_daily_rate, t1.rental_income, t1.service_fee_amortization_rate, t1.service_fee_amortization_income, t1.xirr_rate, t1.actual_repayment_date, t1.actual_repayment_principal_balance, t1.actual_repayment_principal_amount, t1.actual_repayment_interes_balance, t1.actual_repayment_interes_amount, t1.recapture_status, t1.overdue_earnings, t1.create_by, t1.create_time, t1.update_by, t1.update_time, t1.del_flag, t1.message_id, t1.system_code, t1.periods, t1.org_id, t1.accrued, t1.income_provision_method, t1.amortized, t1.comment, t1.source_irr_rate from eg_repayment_plan_hy t1 inner join ( select contract_code , max(plan_date) plan_date from eg_repayment_plan_hy where del_flag='0' and plan_date <= #{initDate} group by contract_code ) t2 on t1.contract_code = t2.contract_code and t1.plan_date = t2.plan_date where del_flag ='0' order by t1.contract_code, t1.plan_date desc
mapper.insert: insert into eg_repayment_plan select * from eg_repayment_plan_hy where exception_type='合同最后期数小于2023-01-01'
mapper.update: with t1 as ( select max(plan_date) plan_date,contract_code from eg_repayment_plan_hy where rent_amount != 0 or principal_amount != 0 or interest_amount != 0 group by contract_code ) update eg_repayment_plan_hy a set del_flag ='1' from t1 where t1.contract_code = a.contract_code and a.del_flag ='0' and a.cash_flow = 0 and a.rent_amount = 0 and a.interest_amount = 0 and a.principal_amount = 0 and a.plan_date > t1.plan_date
